title: The Sister’s Sister
paragraphs: We were starting to get a little worried about how late Father was.
“I-I’m back…”
Father said apologetically, trying to stifle a yawn, looking extremely sleepy. Since Itsuki was already gone to Melromarc, it was Ren and Éclair who responded.
“Naofumi… this isn’t what we agreed on.”
“Leaving aside how long it took… Iwatani-dono, who exactly is that?”

Behind Father, the older sister of that older sister was waving cheerfully. By the way, she’s in her demi-human form. I know who she is. Even Filo-tan relies on her sometimes. She’s the older sister of that older sister who’s incredibly dependable and sometimes appears in her demi-human form. She’s Filo-tan’s older sister’s older sister. Of course, I can understand her words.
“Oh my?”
The older sister of that older sister was looking at Éclair. Noticing her gaze, Éclair spoke up.
“What is it? Do you want something from me?”
“…Nothing at all. I just thought you were beautiful.”
“So, Naofumi, is that a panda who’s turned into a demi-human?”
“Uh, no…”
Father answered while averting his gaze, looking a bit troubled. Ren and Éclair let out sighs.
“Nano! Naofumi isn’t coming back, nano! I looked everywhere… nano?”
“Ah, Naofumi’s here!”
It seems Rival and Sakura-chan had been looking for Father because he was late. They had just returned and were now looking at Father with a curious expression.
“This country is said to be the land that never sleeps, and just like Siltvelt, there are nocturnal demi-humans. I can understand why Iwatani-dono would be late, but…”
“Um, that panda person… her name’s Larsa. I was blending into the group, trying to talk to her, but…”
“Oh my, Naofumi-chan, were you trying to get close to Sasa-chan?”
The older sister of that older sister spoke to Father in a familiar tone. As always, she’s quite the lively one.
“Well, before I knew it, Larsa was gone, and somehow, I ended up drinking and chatting with this person…”
“Naofumi-chan, you’re so good at holding your liquor. I got a little too excited. Ehehe!”
She’s in an incredibly cheerful mood. And she reeks of alcohol. Ren and Éclair seemed to have picked up on that as well and looked a bit uncomfortable.
“Naofumi, even after being trapped by that princess, you’re involving yourself with another strange woman?”
“W-When you put it like that…”
“Hey hey, Naofumi-chan, let’s have another drinking contest!”
“My stomach’s already sloshing, I can’t take anymore… The tavern staff were begging us to leave, remember? Even after that, we kept drinking.”

From Father’s account, it seems that at some point, he ended up in a drinking contest with the older sister of that older sister at the tavern. Even though Father doesn’t get drunk, he had been drinking to get closer to the panda, but somehow ended up locked in an endless drinking contest with the older sister of that older sister, who became his opponent. At first, the crowd that had been egging them on gradually backed off, shocked by how incredibly strong Father and the older sister of that older sister were when it came to drinking. Not only that, but they seemed to hit it off and have a good conversation. Apparently, the panda was still around at that point. While drinking and lightly gambling at a casino with the older sister of that older sister, at some point, only she was left. Then, just before sunrise, they decided to head out to sea to enjoy the beautiful view while continuing their drinking on a small island, mixed in with a bit of hunting.
“The sea was really beautiful. There were monsters, but she was so strong that I didn’t have to do anything.”
“It was so much fun~! Next time, let’s bring Sasa-chan along too.”
“Ah… I’m not sure about that.”
Father looked over at Ren with a troubled expression.
“If you don’t like it, just send her away.”
“Y-Yeah.”
“Oh no~! I want to get closer to Naofumi-chan!”
The older sister of that older sister was getting carried away. She was completely drunk by now.
“I’ll introduce you to Sasa-chan later, so Naofumi-chan, let’s get along better~”
“Hmm… I think I can manage to meet her on my own, so I’ll have to decline.”
“Oh my, you’re such a tough one.”
The older sister of that older sister gave a relaxed smile. As expected of Filo-tan’s older sister’s older sister. She’s the very definition of composure.
“Father, this person is the older sister of that older sister.”
“Hmm? Motoyasu, you know her?”
“Yes, indeed. She’s the older sister of that older sister and quite an exceptional individual.”
“Oh?”
The older sister of that older sister looked at us with a slightly puzzled expression. Her face didn’t betray much emotion, but it seemed like something was on her mind.
“So, I was right. Motoyasu, what kind of person is she?”
“She’s the older sister of that older sister, and she helped manage the village that Father was overseeing. I remember Filo-tan relied on her as well. She’s quite talented.”

I recall that Father once mentioned something about slave training precautions. He explained how they experimented with the older sister of that older sister to see how much her potential could be raised. Apparently, she had considerable skill and potential for growth. Father even said that, excluding the Heroes, she was on par with or possibly even stronger than Filo-tan. Well, that was before Filo-tan was chosen as the Claw Hero.
“If I remember correctly… her name is Sadina.”
“Eh?”
Father looked at the older sister of that older sister. She blinked, slightly surprised. But then, she quickly gave a warm smile.
“Oh my, I’m surprised you know my name~ I’ve been using a fake name in this country~.”
“H-Huh… So, your name is Sadina?”
“That’s right~.”
The older sister of that older sister linked her arm around Father’s arm. Physical contact, I see. She used to do that with Father in the first world too.
“So, Naofumi-chan, who are these people? Are they your friends?”
“Ah… well, something like that.”
Father chose his words carefully. He didn’t introduce them. It seems like he’s being cautious. Ren was observing Father’s behavior as if he had realized something.
What’s the matter?
“So, Naofumi-chan, why do you guys want to get close to Sasa-chan? Depending on the situation, I might be willing to help~.”
“If Motoyasu knows her, I suppose it’s fine, right? Naofumi, you’ll have a lot to do in Zeltoble anyway. Sadina, was it? Do you know much about Zeltoble?”
“I haven’t been here that long, but I know a little~.”
Ren and Éclair both nodded. It looks like they’ve come to an agreement.
“This could be convenient, right?”
“Hmm. To be honest, it would be difficult for just us to locate Lady Imia’s relatives in Zeltoble. If Kitamura considers her trustworthy, we should ask for her help.”
“Well… yeah, I guess so. Anyway, Sadina, since you’ve been up all night, how about you go home or to an inn to rest first?”
At Father’s suggestion, the older sister of that older sister placed her hand on her cheek and responded.
“Oh my~… Well, you’re right. Even I’m a little sleepy. How about we meet up at the tavern where I met Naofumi-chan around snack time?”
“Y-Yes, thank you.”
“Okay, okay~. See you later then. I’m looking forward to it~.”
With that, the older sister of that older sister left in a carefree manner. After seeing her off, Father let out a big yawn.
“I’m so tired…”
“Then you should have gone home earlier.”

“Well, how should I put it… Sadina has a really good flow when she talks. Before I was summoned, I used to get caught up in conversations at drinking parties until morning sometimes, and it felt like that.”
So, he just couldn’t find the right time to leave, huh?
“Well, from what I can tell, she seems to be well-connected. She’d be useful for searching for people in this country. While you’re at it, try to recruit that panda too.”
When Ren said that to Father, he had a somewhat conflicted expression. Eventually, Father turned toward me and asked.
“Yeah, I guess so. But Motoyasu-kun, who exactly is that person again? I just want to confirm it once more.”
“Motoyasu’s explanations are always lacking. Even when he explained about that companion of Itsuki’s, it was incomplete. We should get more details.”
“I agree. Can that person really be trusted? No… I feel like I’ve seen that woman somewhere before…”
Éclair seemed to be deep in thought.
